title: Aliquot
summary: AL'IQUOT, adjective [Latin] An aliquot part of a number or quantity is one which will measure it without a remainder. Thus 5 is the aliquot part of 15.

inlines.v: AL'IQUOT, adjective [Latin] An aliquot part of a number or quantity is one which will measure it without a remainder. Thus 5 is the aliquot part of 15.
